versions.subject: Add proc_creation_win_msdt_diagcab
versions.detection:
selection_img:
  - Image|endswith: '\msdt.exe'
  - OriginalFileName: 'msdt.exe'
selection_cmd:
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - '/cab'
    - '.diagcab'
condition: all of selection_*
